n = int(input())
MOD = 10**9 + 7

dpTable = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(2 * n)]
totalCount = 0
dpTable[0][0] = 1

for i in range(1, 2 * n):
    dpTable[i][0] = dpTable[i - 1][1]
    dpTable[i][n] = dpTable[i - 1][n - 1]
    for k in range(1, n):
        dpTable[i][k] = (dpTable[i - 1][k - 1] + dpTable[i - 1][k + 1]) % MOD
    if i % 2 == 1:
        for k in range(min(i, 2 * n - i) + 1):
            totalCount = (totalCount + dpTable[i][k]) % MOD

print(totalCount)
